Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Anil - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Anita - 32 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Shalini - 64 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Vikram - 34 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Meenakshi - 34 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Anita stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near her.]

Shalini: "Let's do something fun today."

[Anita washes clothes in a bucket.]

Shalini: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Anil stands by the road. Shalini stands near him.]

Anil: "Let's begin."

[Anil rides his motorbike to the market.]

Anil: "Exactly right."

[Anil starts his scooter and rides off.]

Anil: "I knew it!"

[Anil drives the car to the office.]

Anil (happily): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Anil gets out of the car.]

Anil: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Anil stands in the living room. Shalini, Anita and Vikram stand near him.]

Anil: "Let's begin."

[Anil pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Anil (laughing): "Well done!"

[Anil sips red wine.]

Anita (excited): "What next?"

[Anil drinks a beer.]

Anil: "Yes, of course."

[Anil staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Anil and Mother clink their glasses.]

Anil: "What a day to remember!"
